//: nixpkgs is pinned because devbox's default channel (nixpkgs 26.11) dropped x86_64-darwin support. nixos-25.05 still builds on both Intel and Apple Silicon macOS, and on x86_64-linux for CI.
//scripts: `test` runs every suite in tools/. `check` takes an explicit bundle path — this repo has no .arche/ of its own to default to, so try `devbox run check tools/fixtures/pre_okf`. Note: keys under `shell.scripts` are not comments to devbox, so notes live up here.

check: if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then echo 'usage: devbox run check <bundle-dir>' >&2; exit 2; fi
